The “Boost Your Intelligence and Brain Power” Meditation employs Agesta’s sacred codes to trigger positive transformations in your life. To experience tangible change, practice this meditation for 9, 15, or 21 days.

To speed up your progress, it is highly recommended to first complete the “Inner Cleanse” meditation sessions.

Sacred codes are numerical patterns believed to facilitate a connection with higher frequencies, aid in manifesting intentions, and encourage healing. Introduced by channellers such as Jose Gabriel Uribe (Agesta), these sequences come from beings of light and act as a spiritual technology to enhance human consciousness.

Simply repeat the numerical sequence—either silently or aloud—while in a meditative state. This approach, which merges numerology, meditation, and energy healing, has led many practitioners to report positive experiences. Whether you seek manifestation, healing, or spiritual development, these numerical sequences offer a unique and fascinating tool.

Meditation’s Benefits and Sacred Codes:

  • Find an immediate solution (Code: 7 41)

  • Eliminate self-sabotage (Code: 5 93)
  • Gain self-control and discipline (Code: 26 20 0)
  • Control your mind (Code: 85)
  • Dissipate attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (Code: 91)
  • Be an organized person (Code: 80 2)

  • Know the next step (Code: 11 4)
  • Strengthen your nervous system (Code: 8 20)
  • Improve your talents (Code: 8)

  • Increase your intelligence (Code: 15 23)
  • Multiply the signals (Code: 62 41 3)
  • Interpret the signals (Code: 26 1 5)

  • Strengthen your crown chakra (Code: 2 0 4)
  • Increase your intuition (Code: 8 11)
  • Achieve balance (Code: 8 97)
  • Embrace gratitude in all aspects of your life (Code: 33 33)
